review.why: Short, concrete guidance for analyzing a job description, tailoring a CV, writing a cover letter and weighing an offer.
review.summary: Covers discrete job search tasks for software engineers: splitting must-have from nice-to-have requirements in a job description, tailoring a CV, writing a short cover letter, evaluating an offer and drafting a follow-up email.
strengths: Cover letter and follow-up rules are specific
cautions: Salary advice is generic and not sourced
